David / Lauren — quick internal note before we send anything back to BlueWave. I ran numbers on their usage trace and modeled three practical bindings:

- Temp top-up (Option A): No SLA change, activate within 48 hours. Margin impact modest. Recommended for customers needing immediate headroom.

- Staged uplift (Option B): We set a guaranteed floor at the uplifted commit; overage unit price = uplifted unit price + 20% premium (this prevents sustained overages from being billed at a lower unit rate). That gives them spike protection but preserves economics.

- Annualize + co-term (Option C): We can offer Net 45 with a 2% prompt-pay credit for Net 30. Discount at 22% off list assumes a 12-month annualized commit and a minimum 6-month ramp window. Legal will need to sign a simple amendment (I can draft).

Credit request: I can authorize a one-time $8k invoice credit applied to September if we get verbal commitment to Option B or C by EOD Thu. That buys them margin while contracts process.
